description: This Java class implements DHL shipment services, including rate estimation, registration, and shipment confirmation, using DHL's ShipIT XML API. It handles request creation, sending, and response parsing, with support for error handling and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: DhlConnectException
classes.description: Custom exception class for DHL connection errors, extending GeneralException.

methods.name: sendDhlRequest
methods.description: Sends an XML request to DHL's API endpoint, handling connection setup, timeout, and response retrieval.

methods.name: dhlRateEstimate
methods.description: Requests a shipping rate estimate from DHL for a given shipment, constructing the request, sending it, and parsing the response.

methods.name: handleDhlRateResponse
methods.description: Parses the DHL rate estimate XML response, extracting charge details and handling errors.

methods.name: dhlRegisterInquire
methods.description: Registers a DHL account to obtain a shipping key, sending an XML request and processing the response.

methods.name: handleDhlRegisterResponse
methods.description: Parses the registration response XML to extract the shipping key and handle errors.

methods.name: dhlShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Confirms a shipment with DHL, generating label and tracking info, and updating shipment segment records.

methods.name: handleDhlShipmentConfirmResponse
methods.description: Processes the shipment confirmation response, decoding label images, and updating shipment segment status.

methods.name: createAccessRequestDocument
methods.description: Creates an XML document for DHL access requests using configuration parameters.

methods.name: handleErrors
methods.description: Extracts and logs error messages from DHL response XML elements.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for DHL shipment gateway, either from database or properties file.
